capabilities: save IMA articles as Obsidian notes
keep original PDF, image, audio, and video files
convert existing PDF text into notes with links to originals
preserve original IMA folder names and subfolder levels
skip already-saved articles and report save results
disambiguation: Not a cross-device sync tool; it saves articles and files from the IMA app into the vault.
extras: Windows 10+ only and requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; some sidebar text and messages remain in Chinese; the plugin only saves material — AI tools for organizing it need separate setup; the listing carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice.
problem: Material shared through IMA is hard to keep locally and use alongside Obsidian notes when writing or studying.

relations.evidence: Save articles and files shared through IMA as notes and files in Obsidian.

summary: Saves articles and files shared through the IMA app into the vault as notes and files, with PDF-to-note conversion and folder preservation.
